segments.name: Data connectivity services
segments.description: Provides international and local data connectivity services, Wi-Fi terminals and cloud SIM platform services to users and enterprise customers.
segments.evidence: The Group has determined that there is only one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Users and enterprise customers pay data connectivity service fees, retail and business customers pay for terminals and data products, and business partners pay fees for cloud SIM platform services.
revenueModel.evidence: Business partners using the platform are charged service fees for the use of the cloud SIM platform services.
